name: Twin City Fan Companies, Ltd.
old_description: “TCFC has provided many new opportunities if you look for them. I went from being a truck driver in a previous life to a welder here, and now a Robot Technician where I get to program. I have been here a couple of different times since 1989 and it has always been stable and consistent. These days I enjoy the 4 day work week.”
about:
Twin City Fan Companies, Ltd. is headquartered in Mitchell, South Dakota, and was founded in 1989. The company operates as a group of brands—Twin City Fan, Aerovent, and Clarage—that together produce a full range of air moving equipment. While the firm emphasizes a family-oriented culture, the input does not specify its ownership structure or identify individual founders.

The company manufactures centrifugal, axial, and wall-mounted fans, along with power roof ventilators, air make-up units, and door heaters. Its product portfolio targets applications from heavy industrial material handling to commercial HVAC supply and exhaust systems. The homepage notes thousands of installations worldwide, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Primary markets include heavy industrial material handling and commercial HVAC. The company serves customers needing air movement solutions for technically complex installations, but specific client names or industry verticals beyond those two broad categories are not provided.

Leadership cites a values-driven culture—family atmosphere, passion for excellence, uncompromised integrity, and accountability—as the foundation of its global reputation. The firm positions itself as a go-to source for the most technically demanding fan applications, backed by a track record of successful projects across the globe.
